parts.text: A quantity of gas is trapped by a piston in a cylinder with thin metal walls. The piston is free to move without friction within the cylinder. Fig. 4.1 shows the cylinder and piston. Fig. 4.1 The cylinder is placed inside a freezer.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The air in the freezer is at atmospheric pressure, which is 1.0 × 10 5 Pa. The area of the piston in contact with the air in the freezer is 2.4 × 10 –3 m 2 .
